Implement the generator layer for sdr v2 at /Users/apple/Documents/office/SDDAndAIProgramming/v2 with strict TDD. Do NOT copy from v1/src or v1/tests.

## Rules
- Only edit/commit under v2/
- Commits: `test: [T-0xx] 红 — …` then `feat: [T-0xx] 绿 — …`
- cwd: /Users/apple/Documents/office/SDDAndAIProgramming/v2
- Use existing types, clock, config (loadWorkBlocks/loadKeywordRules), store (createRepo, SUMMARY_ROWS_SQL), errors
- Update eslint: files in src/generator/** must not import collectors (no-restricted-imports)

## Modules (T-011～T-016)

### extract.ts — classifyState(text, rules) → {state, confidence}
- Match KeywordRule patterns; highest weight wins; no hit → {doing, 0}
- tests with ≥10 Chinese samples, accuracy ≥90%

### timeline.ts — assignBlocks(events, blocks, clock)
- Rest-interval events fall into previous work block (IR-05)
- Overlap already validated in config; use minutesOfDay from clock
- Return Map<blockName, Event[]>

### attribution.ts — resolveAttribution(event, ctx)
Context needs: parse Co-authored-by from detail/payload; member lookup by github login; optional task window co-operators
Three paths:
1. Co-authored-by → kind coauthor, all members (primary=author, co=others), confirmed true
2. task window operators → task_window, confirmed true
3. fallback → author only, confirmed false
NEVER use event.memberId alone as multi-attribution

### phrases.ts + render.ts — renderEntry(entry, links)
- No first person 我/我们/咱 (CS-05)
- links empty → SDR-E601
- note → `来源：…`; url/path as link
- !confirmed → `[待确认]` prefix; members>1 → `（协作）`; originalDate → `（自 M-D 起）`
- sentence ≤60 chars content body preferred

### report.ts — assembleReport(...)
- leave → placeholder entry; no events → blank template status blank (CS-06/14)
- cross-day originalDate (CS-16)
- do not overwrite confirmed unless force
- save via repo.saveReportBundle

### summary.ts — renderSummary(rows) text
- Attendance matrix, counts by state, blocked locator (member+date+`sdr history` hint)
- NO entry content
- findSummaryRows already in repo — re-export or wrap

## Tests
Mirror under tests/generator/*.test.ts
Cover CS-03,05,06,09,14,16 paths.

## Verify
pnpm test tests/generator && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint

## Return commits, test counts, files.
</user_query>
